method: 按城市规模、旅游热度及餐饮目的地特色分配编辑检索量，广州、深圳、佛山、汕头优先加密；不是官方热度排名。先看具体分店、评价量、内容一致性和争议，再决定收录，不按数量硬凑。平台分数不能证明评价真实或保证营业、品质。
methodEn: Editorial research prioritizes city scale, tourism demand and culinary interest, with greater depth in Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Foshan and Shantou. This is not an official ranking. Branch identity, review volume, consistency and concerns are considered before inclusion; platform scores cannot prove authenticity or guarantee opening or quality.
